full_judgment:
D.C. Bhattacharya, J - This appeal is at the instance of defendant No.2 against a judgment of reversal decreeing a suit for declaration of title and recovery of possession. 

 6. Mr. Mozammel Huq, the learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the appellants contends at the outset that the entire judgment of the learned Additional District Judge has been vitiated on account of his failure to formulate any point for determination as required under the provision of Order 41 , rule 31 of the Code of Civil Procedure. According to the learned Advocate, the learned Additional District Judge has failed to grasp the real point in controversy and as such the findings of the trial court have not been considered by the lower appellate court in their correct perspective and as such the said findings have not been properly reversed. The learned Advocate for the appellants has next submitted that both the courts below committed an error of law in failing to construe the deed of lease, Ext, C and kabala, Ext. D correctly and in holding that defendant Nos. 2 and 3 did not acquire any title to the disputed land on the basis of the said documents. Another contention urged on behalf of the appellant is that the finding of possession of the lower appellate court in reversal of the finding given by the trial court in this regard was not proper. The last contention of the learned Advocate for the appellants is that defendant Nos. 2 and 3 having acquired valid title on the basis of Exts C and D which would constitute an out and out sale by defendant No 1 in favour of defendant Nos 2 and 3 and other Suit No 9 of 1949 having been decreed only against defendant No. 1 and the relief prayed for in the said suit against defendant Nos. 2 and 3 having been refused, the title acquired by defendant Nos. and 3 on the basis of Exts. C and D would prevail over any title which may be claimed by the plaintiff on the basis any instrument purported to be executed on behalf of the defendant No.1 after the aforesaid deeds executed in favour of defendant Nos. 2 and 3.
